parsed.explanation: Political hostility is mixed. While state institutions have implemented LGBT-inclusive educational curricula and administrative departments have complied with judicial directives regarding gender markers and marriage registration, top political leadership has displayed overt animus. In April 2026, the newly elected head of government released a video featuring derogatory and homophobic hate speech, triggering death threats from supporters toward the community. Additionally, an opposition political party held an anti-LGBTQ rally in October 2024 as broader anti-LGBTQ rhetoric gained momentum. However, governing bodies do not actively criminalise trans identity, and historical parties previously incorporated gay rights into platforms, indicating hostility is noticeable and vocal among certain political leaders rather than institutionalised state persecution.
